channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kalil sobre adversários: "Não gostam de mim por não gostar de coisa errada"
item.description: Alexandre Kalil, the PDT candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, said his opponents dislike him because he refuses to engage in corrupt practices, referencing an alleged bribery scheme called 'panetone' involving Belo Horizonte's city council and public transport businessmen. He emphasized he is not part of that group and reaffirmed his ethical stance, despite conflicts with figures like Gabriel Azevedo, Marcelo Aro, and Governor Mateus Simões. His candidacy was confirmed at a PDT convention with national support, aiming to avoid a PT alliance in the first round to reduce polarization.

item.title: PT pede que PGR apure Bolsonaro em IA e presença de Milei ao lado de Flávio
item.description: The PT filed a request with the PGR to investigate Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged irregularities at the PL convention, including the use of AI to simulate Jair Bolsonaro's presence and a speech by Argentine President Javier Milei, who endorsed the candidate and attacked Lula and the STF. Petista deputies argue Milei's presence constitutes prohibited foreign participation in a partisan act and that calls for Trump and the U.S. to interfere in Brazilian elections amount to treason.

item.title: Governo chama embaixador do Brasil na Argentina após discurso de Milei
item.description: The Brazilian government summoned its ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, to clarify bilateral relations after Argentine President Javier Milei called Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'bald trash' during a PL event featuring Flávio Bolsonaro. The Itamaraty deemed the remarks offensive, and Bitelli is expected to meet with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira on Monday (27/7).

item.title: PSD oficializa Caiado como candidato a presidente com críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate at a convention in São Paulo, emphasizing his electoral viability to defeat Lula and criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro as widely rejected by voters. Caiado claimed he is the only candidate who can beat the PT in a runoff, citing his 88% approval as governor of Goiás and referencing Datafolga polls showing Lulu ahead of Bolsonaro in both rounds.

item.title: 'Brasil não pode optar pelos maiores rejeitados da política nacional', diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD candidate for President of Brazil, stated that the country cannot choose candidates who are the most rejected in national politics. He made the remark during the convention that officially launched his candidacy this Sunday in São Paulo. The comment was an indirect criticism of political figures with high disapproval ratings in polls.

item.title: Brasil convoca embaixador na Argentina para consultas após 'ofensas' de Milei
item.description: Brazil summoned its ambassador to Argentina for consultations following offensive remarks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and other officials during an event in São Paulo. The move was announced by Itamaraty as a diplomatic response to the provocations.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro e exalta feitos como governador em Goiás
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in his first official speech, praising his achievements as governor of Goiás in security and education. He linked Lula to corruption and compared Flávio Bolsonaro to a 'factory chicken,' highlighting their high rejection rates (48% and 46%) despite Lula leading with 40% voting intentions. Caiado positioned himself as the only alternative to pull Brazil out of the 'disaster' attributed to the PT and drug trafficking.

item.title: PSD oficializa candidatura de Caiado à presidência da República
item.description: The PSD officially nominated Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate for 2026, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate, at the party’s national convention in São Paulo. Caiado emphasized his 40-year political career, criticized national polarization, and highlighted his tenure as governor of Goiás from 2019 to 2026.

item.title: Governo Lula chama embaixador na Argentina após falas de Milei
item.description: Brazil's Ministry of Foreign Affairs recalled its ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei criticized President Lula and endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy. The move was made in response to Milei's offensive remarks during the PL party's national convention in São Paulo, heightening bilateral tensions without breaking diplomatic relations.

item.title: Zambelli rebate deputado italiano e garante que não fugiu da Justiça
item.description: Former Brazilian deputy Carla Zambelli denied fleeing justice, stating she openly resides in Italy, where she is also a citizen, and that Italian authorities know her address. She rebutted accusations by Italian deputy Angelo Bonelli that she is hiding awaiting possible amnesty if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 elections. Zambelli claimed she is being persecuted by Alexandre de Moraes and noted her release in Italy followed the annulment of her extradition by Italy’s Supreme Court, although she still faces a second extradition proceeding.

item.title: PSD oficializa 166 candidatos em SP e confirma apoio a Tarcísio em convenção estadual
item.description: The PSD officially nominated 166 candidates in São Paulo for the 2026 elections, including 71 for the Chamber of Deputies and 95 for the State Legislative Assembly (Alesp), and confirmed support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election. The party also launched a presidential ticket with Ronaldo Caiado (GO) and Gilberto Kassab (SP) as candidates for President and Vice-President of Brazil. No Senate candidates were officially nominated, though the PSD backs André do Prado and Guilherme Derrite for the two Senate seats.

item.title: Postura de Milei em convenção do PL irrita governo e embaixador do Brasil é convocado
item.description: The Brazilian government summoned its ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, after Argentine President Javier Milei insulted Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes during a PL party convention, calling him 'bald trash' and criticizing the ban on visiting jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro. The move aims to convey dissatisfaction and seek clarification on bilateral relations.

item.title: Nunca me envolvi em rachadinha, Master, INSS ou mensalão, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado denied involvement in corruption schemes such as 'rachadinha', the Banco Master scandal, INSS, and the Mensalão during an interview before the PSD convention that formalized his presidential candidacy in a ticket with Gilberto Kassab. He criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, linking them to past corruption cases, to attract undecided voters and position himself as a morally unblemished candidate outside the political polarization.

item.title: Governo brasileiro convoca embaixador na Argentina após ataques de Milei a Lula e a Moraes
item.description: The Brazilian government summoned its ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, to Brasília after Argentine President Javier Milei called Lula a 'prisoner' and Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash' in a political speech. The summoning, seen as a strong diplomatic protest, occurred after Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira returned from Asia and was informed of the remarks. Milei also criticized Moraes for denying a visit to Jair Bolsonaro and predicted an economic crisis in Brazil under Lula.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula provoca Trump para desviar o foco
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado accused Lula of provoking Trump to divert attention from Brazil's internal problems, claiming the president seeks to create international friction. He promised a 'high-level diplomacy' to restore Brazil's global credibility and criticized useless conflicts that, he said, mask the population's difficulties. Caiado also reaffirmed his presidential candidacy with Gilberto Kassab as running mate, emphasizing his political trajectory and strategy of not relying on Bolsonarist votes.

item.title: Parlamentares do PT acionam PGR por presença de Milei e IA de Bolsonaro em evento de Flávio
item.description: PT lawmakers filed a complaint with the PGR alleging electoral crimes during the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate, citing the presence of Argentine President Javier Milei, who delivered a campaign speech asking for votes and attacking opponents and STF rulings, and an AI-generated video simulating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s endorsement. They argue that foreign participation in partisan acts and AI-driven voter manipulation violate Brazilian electoral law.

item.title: Não é uma eleição de rejeitados, diz Caiado sobre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) claims the 2026 presidential election will not be 'of the rejected', criticizing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for lacking purpose and results. He highlights his governance record in Goiás as proof of capability and cites a PoderData/Aya poll showing 48% rejection for both main rivals. Caiado presents his ticket with Gilberto Kassab as vice as an alternative grounded in purpose and courage for the citizen.

item.title: Caiado diz que em briga de marido e mulher vai "meter tornozeleira"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, launched his campaign in São Paulo advocating strict measures against domestic violence offenders, including electronic ankle monitors, asset confiscation, and transfers to victims. He positioned himself as a 'third way' alternative, criticizing Lula and Bolsonaro without directly naming the latter's son, whom he referred to as a 'kinder egg candidate'.

item.title: A nova demonstração de insatisfação de Lula a Trump após tarifaço sobre produtos brasileiros
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, calling them a strategic mistake that harms bilateral relations. He stated Brazil will not accept political or electoral pressure disguised as trade measures and warned the tariffs could disrupt integrated supply chains.

item.title: Governo chama embaixador do Brasil na Argentina para consultas após falas de Milei em evento do PL
item.description: Brazil summoned its ambassador to Argentina, Julio Bitelli, for consultations after Argentine President Javier Milei made hostile remarks at a PL event, including insults to Minister Alexandre de Moraes and criticism of Brazil’s judiciary. The move signals a firm diplomatic dissatisfaction, especially as Bitelli had previously been called to explain relations in July 2024. Milei endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, linking it to a purported 'blue wave' of liberalism across Latin America.

item.title: “Quem rouba com a mão esquerda e com a direita é ladrão”, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado of the PSD officially launched his presidential candidacy at a national convention in São Paulo, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. In his speech, Caiado positioned himself as an alternative to current political polarization, using the phrase 'Who steals with the left hand and with the right hand is a thief' to denounce systemic corruption. The ticket is composed exclusively of PSD members, emphasizing party unity.

item.title: Deputada aciona STF após vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro em convenção do PL
item.description: Federal deputy Dandara Tonantzin (PT-MG) has urged the STF to act against an AI-generated video featuring the image and voice of Jair Bolsonaro, shown at the PL’s national convention to endorse Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid. She requests that Minister Alexandre de Moraes summon Bolsonaro to clarify whether he authorized the synthetic content, arguing that using his likeness—even if AI-generated—may breach the legal restrictions imposed by the STF following his conviction for leading a coup attempt.

item.title: Lula critica “tarifas” dos EUA em artigo no Washington Post
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized in a Washington Post article the 25% tariffs imposed by the United States on Brazilian goods, calling them ideologically driven and harmful to both economies. He stated that Brazil will not be defeated by lies and will seek new commercial partners to reduce reliance on the U.S., warning that the tariffs will disrupt deeply integrated supply chains.

item.title: PSD oficializa chapa pura com Caiado para Presidência e Kassab como vice
item.description: The PSD officially launched its pure ticket for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, nominating former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate and minister Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. The convention took place on Sunday morning, the 26th, in São Paulo, solidifying the party’s candidacy for the upcoming general elections.

item.title: Caiado lança candidatura como 3ª via e critica "eleição de rejeitados"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado officially launched his presidential candidacy under the PSD, presenting himself as a third-way alternative and criticizing the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, whom he labeled the 'most rejected'. He advocated for rural debt renegotiation, emphasized his clean record free of corruption scandals, praised public safety in Goiás, and proposed confiscating assets from women's abusers, while also attacking Lula as a 'loan shark' and criticizing interest rates.

item.title: PSD oficializa candidatura de Caiado com críticas a Lula e Flávio
item.description: The PSD formally nominated Ronaldo Caiado for president at a convention in São Paulo, without the presence of Tarcísio de Freitas. Caiado criticized both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, presenting himself as an alternative to the 'Kinder Egg candidate' and appealing to independent voters and the 'useful vote' in a polarized 2026 election. He also condemned Javier Milei’s appearance at the PL convention as 'vulgar'.

item.title: A reação do advogado de Bolsonaro a reuniões da pré-campanha de Lula
item.description: João Henrique Nascimento de Freitas, a lawyer in Bolsonaro's defense team, criticized the alleged use of the Palácio da Alvorada by Lula for 2026 pre-campaign meetings, claiming a double standard by the Electoral Justice, which barred Bolsonaro from using the same residence for electoral livestreams in 2022. He questioned whether the TSE's silence on Lula's meetings constitutes a de facto decision that undermines the legal security of electoral rules, despite electoral law prohibiting the use of public property for political benefit, with exceptions for private acts at the official residence.

item.title: Zema diz que cogita Joaquim Barbosa para vice
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, stated he plans to meet with former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa and that Barbosa is among the names being considered for vice president on his ticket. The comment was made during a party event in Rio Grande do Sul.

item.title: Vídeo de Bolsonaro por IA pode ser punido pela justiça eleitoral? Entenda
item.description: An AI-generated video simulating former President Jair Bolsonaro expressing support for his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign was shown during the PL party convention. Electoral law experts say the video may trigger judicial scrutiny, as Bolsonaro is politically barred and forbidden from political acts, though his defense could argue the AI simulation does not constitute a direct manifestation by him. Since the video was displayed at an internal party convention, experts believe it is unlikely to trigger immediate electoral consequences.

item.title: MPF abre procedimento para acompanhar acordo de Goiás com os EUA sobre terras raras
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry (MPF) has opened a procedure to investigate agreements between the Government of Goiás and the United States and Japan regarding rare earth exploration, after not receiving the documents detailing the negotiations. The U.S. agreement, signed in March 2025 under Governor Ronaldo Caiado’s administration, has a five-year term and focuses on governance, investment, and security of critical minerals supply chains, centered on mining in Minaçu by Serra Verde. The MPF is examining potential implications for mineral ownership and federal exclusive competencies, while the case remains under seal and Goiás has 30 days to submit the required documentation.

item.title: Flamengo x São Paulo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Flamengo hosts São Paulo at Maracanã in the 20th round of the Brasileirão on Sunday at 6:30 PM Brasília time, with exclusive broadcast on Premiere. Flamengo, second with 37 points, aims to maintain momentum after a 4-0 win over Chapecoense, led by top scorer Pedro and the return of Arrascaeta. São Paulo, ninth with 25 points, faces instability with four losses in their last five matches and increasing pressure on coach Dorival Júnior following a loss to Athletico-PR.

item.title: Funcionário americano que teve visto negado pelo Itamaraty é nome de Trump para 'guerra cultural' na Europa, diz jornal
item.description: Brazil's Itamaraty denied entry visas to two senior U.S. State Department officials, Riley M. Barnes and Samuel D. Samson, who planned to visit Brazil under the pretext of discussing freedom of expression but whose real aim, according to the Washington Post, was to question the integrity of the Brazilian elections. The denial came in a pre-election context, after presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) had raised doubts about electronic voting machines in an event with diplomats, creating concerns about the visit being instrumentalized. Samson, Deputy Assistant Secretary for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, was described by The New York Times as leading Trump's 'cultural war against Europe,' having met with far-right European groups such as Germany's AfD.

item.title: Jornais argentinos repercutem discurso de Milei em convenção do PL: 'Tensão com o Brasil está mais alta do que nunca'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei spoke at the PL national convention in São Paulo, formalizing Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. Milei launched harsh attacks on Lula, calling him a 'thief', 'convict', and 'socialist trash', which Argentine media widely reported as escalating diplomatic tensions with Brazil. Outlets such as Clarín and El Tiempo emphasized Milei’s direct involvement in the Brazilian campaign, despite criticism over his conduct as a head of state.

item.title: Em artigo no Washington Post, Lula diz que ninguém 'vai nos derrotar com base em mentiras'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) published an article in The Washington Post criticizing U.S. tariffs on Brazilian imports as being based on lies, stating Brazil is considering retaliatory measures, while inviting the Trump administration to continue dialogue.

item.title: 'Brasil precisa de candidato que não tenha surpresinhas', diz Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) said Brazil needs a candidate without 'surprises,' using the metaphor of a 'Kinder egg' to criticize candidates who generate daily controversies. He emphasized his own record as someone who has never been involved in scandals, positioning himself as a stable and predictable option for the 2026 election.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado tenta pela 2ª vez ser presidente do Brasil, após 37 anos
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former senator and governor of Goiás, has been chosen as the PSD's presidential candidate for 2026 after the withdrawal of Ratinho Junior and a victory over Eduardo Leite in the party's internal dispute. At 76, he is making his second attempt to reach the presidency, having received less than 1% of the vote in the 1989 election. His career includes leadership in the UDR, multiple terms as federal deputy, senator, and two terms as governor of Goiás, consistently opposing the PT.

item.title: Caiado diz que, com ele e com ACM, "o povo baiano vai se sentir alforriado"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), presidential candidate, used the term 'alforria' — referring to the emancipation of enslaved people — when commenting on his alliance with ACM Neto in Bahia, stating that 'the Bahian people will feel emancipated.' The term sparked controversy due to its historical association with slavery and was previously used by Caiado regarding Rio de Janeiro's favelas. Caiado is positioning himself as a 'third way' alternative to Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, escalating criticism of his rivals on social media.

item.title: Lula critica tarifaço de Trump e diz que Brasil “não será derrotado por mentiras”
item.description: President Lula criticized Donald Trump's tariffs, stating that Brazil will not be defeated by lies or attempts to instrumentalize bilateral relations for political or electoral purposes. He emphasized that Brazil will not accept using economic or diplomatic ties as tools of ideological coercion, asserting such tactics are unsustainable.

item.title: PSD lança candidatura de Ronaldo Caiado à Presidência da República
item.description: The Social Democratic Party (PSD) officially nominated Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate at a national convention in São Paulo, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. Caiado emphasized his record as governor of Goiás, where he left office with 88% approval, and pledged a 'new model of government' focused on results and courage to overcome political polarization. The ticket is composed solely of PSD members, with no coalitions finalized so far.

item.title: Pesquisa detalha a batalha de rejeição entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Lula's rejection dropped from 55% to 50%, while Flávio Bolsonaro's rose from 52% to 57%, with Lula leading in a hypothetical runoff 45% to 37%. Despite the improvement, 51% of respondents believe Lula does not deserve re-election, and antibolsonarismo increased from 37% to 44%, highlighting an election driven more by rejection than approval.

item.title: Com pré-candidatura a presidente em xeque, Aldo Rebelo vai à convenção de Caiado
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, pre-candidate of the Christian Democracy party (DC) for president, attended the PSD national convention that formalized Ronaldo Caiado’s presidential bid. He praised Caiado’s presence as elevating the quality of the presidential debate and reiterated his own presidential ambitions despite an internal party dispute that replaced his name with former STF minister Joaquim Barbosa, a move he has challenged in court. Aldo stated that, if he secures his candidacy, his priority would be to 'unblock' Brazil, criticizing the STF, Public Ministry, Ibama, Funai, and ICMBio for allegedly paralyzing the country, and emphasized the need to discuss public security and education.

item.title: Trump volta a flertar com terceiro mandato, mesmo com proibição expressa da lei
item.description: Donald Trump hinted at running for a third term in 2028, violating the 22nd Amendment, by wearing a 'Trump 2028' hat and claiming he 'won three times' despite only winning two elections. He repeated baseless fraud claims from 2020, mirroring rhetoric used by Jair Bolsonaro after his 2022 loss in Brazil. The U.S. State Department plans to send officials to Brazil to challenge the integrity of electronic voting machines, prompting pushback from the TSE and Itamaraty.

item.title: Caiado: “Comigo bandido não se cria, comigo PT não se cria”
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) officially launched his presidential bid at the party's national convention in São Paulo, with PSD president Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. In his speech, Caiado declared the election 'the most important in the country's history' and used the slogan: 'With me, criminals are not created, with me the PT is not created,' emphasizing his hardline stance on crime and opposition to the Workers' Party.

item.title: Lula chama tarifas de Trump de erro estratégico em jornal dos EUA
item.description: President Lula criticized U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods as a strategic error, stating they harm both countries and that Brazil will not accept foreign interference in internal affairs. He argued the measures ignore technical justifications and are politically motivated, citing a 12.8% decline in bilateral trade with the U.S. in the first half of 2026, while trade with the EU and China grew. Lula also dismissed Trump’s justifications related to free speech, Pix, and environmental policy, asserting Brazil combats online crime without restricting expression, does not discriminate against U.S. firms in payments, and has significantly reduced deforestation since 2023.

item.title: Bolsonaro de IA para presidente
item.description: The article draws a parallel between Fernando Haddad’s 2018 PT candidacy — nominated while Lula was imprisoned — and the potential nomination of Flávio Bolsonaro to represent Jair Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, also while the former president is incarcerated. It references the PL convention that endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro as evidence of a pattern where imprisoned leaders nominate close relatives or allies. The phrase 'Bolsonaro de IA' implies a metaphor for an artificial or digitally constructed candidacy, possibly tied to image management or algorithmic political strategies.

item.title: Confirmado como candidato do PSD à presidência, Caiado dispara: 'coragem para libertar o país do sequestro do PT e das facções'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado was officially confirmed as the PSD's presidential candidate in a convention held in São Paulo, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. He criticized the PT and criminal factions, accusing the party of 'kidnapping' the country, and distanced himself from candidates involved in corruption scandals. Caiado also condemned foreign interference in Brazil's elections and pledged to strengthen penal legislation against gender-based violence and crimes against children.

item.title: Versão IA de Bolsonaro em Convenção do PL levanta debate sobre uso em campanha eleitoral; veja quais são as regras
item.description: An AI-generated video simulating jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro endorsing his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid was displayed at the PL party convention. The video was clearly labeled as AI-generated, complying with TSE rules requiring disclosure of synthetic content in electoral propaganda. The use of the technology has reignited debate over the ethical and legal boundaries of deepfakes in political campaigns, particularly when involving figures under judicial restrictions.

item.title: A manobra de campanha de Flávio para Bolsonaro ‘participar’ de convenção do PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign used artificial intelligence to simulate Jair Bolsonaro's participation in the PL's national convention, despite a judicial order prohibiting the former president from making political statements. The AI-generated video opens with a disclaimer stating it is a simulation, but the PT is considering asking the TSE to sanction the tactic as a potential electoral law violation.

item.title: 'Ninguém vai nos derrotar com base em mentiras', diz Lula em artigo no jornal Washington Post
item.description: President Lula published an article in The Washington Post criticizing U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods as a strategic mistake and denying allegations of electoral interference, stating that 'no one will defeat us based on lies'. He emphasized his direct negotiations with Trump and warned that the tariffs harm both the U.S. economy and bilateral relations. Brazil denied visas to two U.S. State Department officials who, according to reports, intended to question the integrity of Brazil's electoral system.

item.title: Lula diz a jornal que tem mecanismos de reciprocidade para lidar com tarifas de Trump
item.description: President Lula stated that U.S. tariffs on Brazil are a strategic error and said Brazil has mechanisms to ensure reciprocity. He published an article in The Washington Post defending Brazil's position against U.S. trade measures.
